description: New Hampshire motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: What does New Hampshire require for a motorcycle helmet?
questions.explanation: RSA 265:122 requires a helmet for riders and passengers under 18. New Hampshire has no helmet law for adults, but a helmet is still the safe choice.

questions.q: A New Hampshire rider who is 18 or older and rides without a helmet
options: Is not breaking a state helmet law
Breaks the law only on highways
Breaks the law only at night
questions.explanation: RSA 265:122's helmet rule covers riders and passengers under 18. An adult may ride without one, though it is still the safer choice. Carrying a passenger under 18 who has no helmet is a violation.

questions.q: What does New Hampshire law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
questions.explanation: New Hampshire: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

provenance.manual: State of New Hampshire Driver Manual

questions.q: In New Hampshire, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
questions.explanation: New Hampshire issues a motorcycle permit at 16 years at the earliest.
